<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    std::stringstream ss;
    std::string buffer;
    InputReader() {
        buffer.reserve(1024);
    }
    int next() {
        while (!(ss >> buffer)) {
            if (!std::getline(std::cin, buffer))
                return -1;
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(buffer);
        }
        return std::stoi(buffer);
    }
    bool hasMoreTokens() {
        while (!(ss >> buffer)) {
            if (!std::getline(std::cin, buffer))
                return false;
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(buffer);
        }
        return true;
    }
    int nextInt() { return next(); }
    long long nextLong() { return std::stoll(buffer); }
    double nextDouble() { return std::stod(buffer); }
};

struct Edge {
    int u, flow, rid, cost;
    Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), rid(c), cost(d) {}
};

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;
    std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> al;
    std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> ja;
    std::vector<int> d;
    int edges = 0;

    std::vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) : N(n), S(source), T(sink), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        al.resize(N);
        d.resize(N);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = (int)al[u].size(), lv = (int)al[v].size();
        al[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        al[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        ja.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            ja[i] = al[i];
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
        std::fill(d.begin(), d.end(), gmax);
        d[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (auto &e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) {
                        d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (auto &e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool simple() {
        node.resize(N);
        visit.resize(N);
        prv.resize(N);
        prve.resize(N);
        dist.resize(N);
        std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), gmax);
        node[0] = S;
        dist[0] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = node[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                auto &e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                        node[front] = e.u;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        node[back] = e.u;
                    }
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    prv[e.u] = u;
                    dist[e.u] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    struct Pair {
        int F, S;
        Pair(int a, int b) : F(a), S(b) {}
        bool operator<(const Pair &other) const {
            return S > other.S; // for min-heap
        }
    };

    bool dijkstra() {
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, 0);
        prve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, gmax);
        std::priority_queue<Pair> pq;
        pq.emplace(S, 0);
        dist[S] = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (dist[p.F] < p.S) continue;
            visit[p.F] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[p.F].size(); i++) {
                auto &e = ja[p.F][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = p.S + e.cost + d[p.F] - d[e.u];
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                    pq.emplace(e.u, cdist);
                    dist[e.u] = cdist;
                    prv[e.u] = p.F;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T, minVal = gmax;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
            if (val < minVal) minVal = val;
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= minVal;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += minVal;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minVal;
        return minVal;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        // Uncomment to check for negative cycles
        // bool possible = BellmanFord(true);
        // if (!possible) return false;
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (visit[i] != 0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        // set true to check for negative cycles
        // bool possible = BellmanFord(false);
        // if (!possible) return false;
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int minVal = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += minVal * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    int c = in.nextInt();
    int d = in.nextInt();

    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);
    std::vector<int> a(k + 1, 0);
    std::vector<int> f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        a[i] = in.nextInt();
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int a = in.nextInt(), b = in.nextInt();
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                if (a != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    ans.convertToArray();
    ans.calWithPotential();
    // ans.calSimple();
    if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
        std::cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << ans.minCost << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
